content:
We need to identify elements based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool to get spectrum. Then analyze isotopic patterns: e.g., chlorine shows M+2 ~ 1/3 intensity of M, bromine M+2 ~ equal intensity, sulfur shows small M+2 ~ 4% etc. We need to list all elements that can be definitively identified from the pattern.

We need to retrieve spectrum first.
